_help: Meal ideas for the Nutrition tab. Add your own by copying an entry and changing it.
name: what the meal is. English with the Finnish name in parentheses.
slot: when it is eaten: breakfast, lunch, dinner, snack or recovery (straight after a workout).
days: which days it suits: rest, easy, quality (tempo/intervals), long (long run), carb-load, race-morning.
carbs / protein: high, moderate or low. Shown as a hint next to the meal.
The file must stay valid JSON: double quotes, a comma between entries, no comma after the last one.
